pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **Rafe, the Noisemaker, is a walking disaster who drafts like a toddler on a sugar rush.** Let me tell you something, Rafe, look at me! LOOK AT ME! You've got Germany, a powerhouse in Tier 1, and yet here you are languishing in last place, only proving that even a broken clock is right twice a day. Your Tier 2 picks of Ecuador and Mexico show the kind of reckless hope that only pure chaos could muster. When Ghana faced Colombia, Zach's pick of Ghana laid an egg. Zach, you call yourself Mustard Boy, but at this rate, you're just plain ketchup — always trailing behind. Devin, Ghost Pepper, you drafted Bosnia. Bosnia, really? That's the kind of decision-making that says you've got the spice but not the substance. Gayden, the Backpass Assassin, you've got England leading your charge, but a safe bet can't save a play-it-safe mindset. Gunner, Bubba G — sitting at the top of the standings and clinging to that paper-thin lead like a man who just found a dollar in a dumpster. But let me make a prediction: when the dust settles, you all are going to see just how misplaced your delusions of grandeur were. Here's the truth, folks: this isn't fantasy — it's a fantasy for you guys to think you're good at this.
